title: 美國的生活
footer: Teacher Dom · Life in America 美國的生活

strip.zh: Dom 的家鄉建市那一年

lines.en: I come from Huntington Beach, California.
lines.zh: 我來自加州的杭廷頓海灘。

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

lines.en: Today, I will show you MY America.
lines.zh: 今天，我要帶你們看看「我的」美國。

slides.ask_en: What do you already know about America?
slides.ask_zh: 關於美國，你已經知道些什麼？

prompts.en: Stand up if you have eaten a hamburger.
Stand up if you have watched an American movie.
prompts.zh: 看過美國電影的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you dressed up for Halloween at Chingshan.
prompts.zh: 在青山萬聖節變裝過的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: You already know a little about America. Today, let's meet the real one.
slides.punch_zh: 你們已經認識一點點美國了。今天，來認識真正的美國。

slides.head_en: From Surf City to Baiguo Mountain
slides.ask_en: I grew up by the ocean. You are growing up by a mountain. Let's compare our lives!
slides.ask_zh: 我在海邊長大，你們在山腳下長大。來比比看我們的生活！

slides.q_en: About how many Taiwans can fit inside California?
slides.q_zh: 加州裡面大約放得下幾個台灣？
slides.explain_en: About 12! California is 11.7 times bigger than Taiwan. And the whole USA? About 270 Taiwans!
slides.explain_zh: 大約 12 個！加州是台灣的 11.7 倍大。那整個美國呢？大約 270 個台灣！

slides.body_en: Huntington Beach is a beach city in Southern California. Its nickname is “Surf City USA.” It has a long pier that walks you out over the ocean, and every summer, surfers from around the world come to compete there.
slides.body_zh: 杭廷頓海灘是南加州的海邊城市，綽號叫「美國衝浪之城」。那裡有一座長長的碼頭，可以一路走到海面上；每年夏天，世界各地的衝浪好手都會來這裡比賽。

slides.ask_en: Palm trees line the beach in my hometown. When I saw your courtyard, I felt right at home.
slides.ask_zh: 我家鄉的海邊種滿棕櫚樹。看到你們的中庭，我覺得好像回到家了。

items.en: A big yellow bus takes kids to school
items.zh: 大大的黃色校車載小孩上學

items.en: The whole class takes a nap after lunch
Lunch is served in the classroom
Middle school kids get their own hallway locker
items.zh: 國中生在走廊有自己的置物櫃

items.en: Kids call their teacher “Ms. Lee” or “Mr. Smith”
items.zh: 小朋友叫老師「Ms. Lee」或「Mr. Smith」

slides.q_en: In most American schools, who cleans the classrooms?
slides.q_zh: 在大多數的美國學校，誰來打掃教室？
slides.explain_en: A custodian! Many Americans are surprised that Taiwanese students clean their own school. It teaches you to take care of your place.
slides.explain_zh: 校工！很多美國人很驚訝：台灣學生自己打掃學校。這讓你們學會照顧自己的地方。

slides.q_en: Thanksgiving is on the fourth Thursday of November. What date is it this year?
slides.q_zh: 感恩節在 11 月的第四個星期四。今年是幾月幾日？
slides.explain_en: November 26, just nine days from today! It is one of the biggest family holidays in America.
slides.explain_zh: 11 月 26 日，再過 9 天就到了！它是美國最重要的家庭節日之一。

slides.body_en: Families come together for a big dinner: turkey, mashed potatoes, and pumpkin pie. Before eating, many families go around the table, and each person says one thing they are thankful for.
slides.body_zh: 全家人聚在一起吃大餐：火雞、馬鈴薯泥和南瓜派。開動之前，很多家庭會繞著餐桌輪流，每個人說一件自己感謝的事。

slides.body_en: At Chingshan, you dressed up as ghosts, witches and pirates. In America, kids in costumes walk from house to house in their neighborhood. They knock on the door and say, “Trick or treat!” Neighbors give them candy.
slides.body_zh: 在青山，你們扮成鬼、女巫和海盜。在美國，穿著變裝的小孩會在社區裡一家一家地走，敲門說「Trick or treat！」，鄰居就會給他們糖果。

slides.body_en: In Taiwan, scooters are everywhere. In most of America, families drive cars, because towns are far apart. In California, you can get a driver's license at 16.
slides.body_zh: 在台灣，到處都是機車。在美國大部分地方，家家戶戶開車，因為城鎮之間離得很遠。在加州，16 歲就可以考駕照。

slides.q_en: On a hot day in Yuanlin, it is 30°C. Americans use Fahrenheit. What is 30°C in °F?
slides.q_zh: 員林大熱天是攝氏 30 度。美國人用華氏，30°C 是華氏幾度？
slides.explain_en: 86°F! Multiply by 9, divide by 5, then add 32. So if an American says “It's 100 degrees!”, that's about 38°C.
slides.explain_zh: 華氏 86 度！乘以 9、除以 5、再加 32。所以美國人說「100 度！」的時候，其實大約是攝氏 38 度。

slides.head_zh: 迷思還是事實？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Every American lives in a big house.
items.zh: 每個美國人都住大房子。
items.note_en: Myth! Many people live in apartments, just like in Taiwan.
items.note_zh: 迷思！很多人住公寓，跟台灣一樣。

items.note_en: Myth! Americans eat tacos, pho, sushi, pizza… and yes, bubble tea!
items.note_zh: 迷思！美國人也吃墨西哥捲餅、越南河粉、壽司、披薩……還有珍珠奶茶！

items.en: Kids in America have homework, too.
items.zh: 美國小孩也有回家功課。
items.note_zh: 事實！抱歉，誰都逃不過回家功課。

items.note_en: Myth! American families come from every part of the world.
items.note_zh: 迷思！美國人的家族來自世界各地。

slides.body_en: Near my hometown is Little Saigon, one of the biggest Vietnamese communities outside Vietnam. My neighbors speak Spanish, Vietnamese, Tagalog, Korean and Chinese. I can speak Vietnamese and Tagalog, too!
slides.body_zh: 我家鄉附近有「小西貢」，是越南以外最大的越南社區之一。我的鄰居說西班牙語、越南語、他加祿語、韓語和中文。我也會說越南語和他加祿語喔！

slides.q_en: In Tagalog, the language of the Philippines, “Salamat” means…
slides.q_zh: 在菲律賓的他加祿語裡，「Salamat」是什麼意思？
slides.explain_en: Thank you! In Vietnamese, it's “Cảm ơn.” Every language has a way to say thank you.
slides.explain_zh: 謝謝！越南語的謝謝是「Cảm ơn」。每一種語言都有說謝謝的方法。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many foods you can eat in America as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「在美國吃得到的食物」越好，我來數！

slides.head_zh: 像美國小孩一樣說英文

items.zh: 李老師早安！（叫姓，不叫 Teacher）

slides.prompt_en: If you could spend one week in America, what would you want to see or do?
slides.prompt_zh: 如果可以在美國待一個星期，你最想看什麼、做什麼？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

lines.zh: 你最喜歡的 ______ 是什麼？

slides.tip_en: Write one question. I will answer as many as I can!
slides.tip_zh: 寫下一個問題，我會盡量每一題都回答！

slides.head_zh: 這個月可以試試的 3 件事

items.en: Greet your English teacher by name: “Good morning, Ms. ___!”
items.zh: 叫英文老師的名字打招呼：「Good morning, Ms. ___！」

items.en: On November 26, tell your family one thing you are thankful for.
items.zh: 11 月 26 日，跟家人說一件你感謝的事。

items.en: Find California and Taiwan on a map, and trace the way I flew.
items.zh: 在地圖上找到加州和台灣，畫出我飛來的路線。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Chingshan Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell Dom what you want to see in America.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到青山國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴 Dom 你最想在美國看到什麼。
slides.sentence_en: One day, I want to see ______ in America.

slides.big_zh: 不一樣的地方，一樣的心。
